research_result.description: Zoho Cliq provides REST APIs (v2 and v3) covering channels, messages, bots, datastores, and admin capabilities, along with an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agent integration.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can create a free Zoho account and register an application in the Zoho API Console to obtain a Client ID and Client Secret, or create a Self Client for automated testing without redirect URIs.

evidence.claim: Zoho Cliq provides a REST API (v3) based on RESTful architecture principles.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Zoho Cliq's REST API is designed based on RESTful architecture principles, enabling seamless communication between your applications and Zoho Cliq.

evidence.claim: Zoho Cliq API uses OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The first step in using OAuth authentication is registering your app with the Zoho API console.

evidence.claim: Developers can create a free Zoho account to access Zoho REST APIs.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You can create a free account to get started.

evidence.claim: Registering an application yields a Client ID and Client Secret used to obtain OAuth tokens.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Upon successful registration of your application, you will receive a Client ID and Client Secret.

evidence.claim: Zoho Cliq offers an official MCP Server for AI model and agent integration.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Zoho Cliq MCP Server brings your chats into the world of AI using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
